title: P.4 Linear Equations in Two Variables

icans: I can find the slope of a line.
I can write the equation of a line from a point and a slope or two points.
I can write equations of parallel and perpendicular lines.

vocab: the ratio of the __________ in y to the change in x

blocks.p: Graph y = mx + 2 with a slider for m.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Slope: m = _______________. Horizontal lines have slope 0; vertical lines have undefined slope.

blocks.stem:
Find the slope through each pair.
a.  (−2, 0), (3, 1)
b.  (−1, 2), (2, 2)
c.  (0, 4), (1, −1)
Write the equation of the line through (1, −2) with slope 3, in slope-intercept form.
Write the equation of the line through (2, 3) and (−3, 6).

notes: Parallel lines have equal slopes; perpendicular lines have slopes that are _______________ (m₁m₂ = −1).

blocks.stem: Write the lines through (2, −1) that are (a) parallel and (b) perpendicular to 2x − 3y = 5.
A machine costs $12,000 and is worth $2,000 after 8 years. Write a linear model for its value V after t years.
Write the line through (8, 3) perpendicular to y = 4x − 1.

tickets.stem: Write the line with y-intercept −3 and slope 1/2.
Are y = 2x + 1 and y = −(1/2)x parallel, perpendicular, or neither?
